name: Pulling Straps
mobile: Shoulders; upper spine in the lifted layers
summary: Face down on the long box, pull the straps back alongside the body as the chest lifts.
steps: Long box in front of the shoulder rests. Lie face down with the chest at the front edge.
Hold the ropes above the loops, arms long down either side of the frame.
Breathe out to draw straight arms back beside the hips; breathe in to release.

layers.title: Add a chest lift
layers.text: Lift the chest as the arms pull.

layers.title: Triceps
layers.text: Hold the arms back and bend and straighten the elbows.

layers.title: Lift and hold
layers.text: Stay up and add small leg beats.

modifications: Stay level (no lift) for a tender lower back.
Bend the knees and cross the ankles.
Slide the hands down to the loops for less resistance.

cautions.note: Keep the range below any shoulder pain.

cues:
Look at the headrest; chin slightly tucked.
Arms stop at hip height.
Elbows stay straight.
Belly lifts so the lower back stays long.

review.note: Draft entry written for OpenPilates. Needs review by a qualified Pilates instructor before teaching from it.
